title: 1997 contact: 10,000 people paid $10 million each

tellings.quote: who said, "We have given at least 10,000 people $10 million each or more to secure their cooperation with what we're doing."

plain: Someone Steven Greer met in Washington in 1997 told him, "We have given at least 10,000 people $10 million each or more to secure their cooperation with what we're doing." Greer, a UFO activist, tells Michels he heard this himself, around the time he was briefing officials in Washington, and he does not name the speaker here. If it is true, the secrecy around UFOs is held together by a huge, paid network of insiders.
